sources.name: CharXiv: Charting Gaps in Realistic Chart Understanding in Multimodal LLMs (arXiv:2406.18521v1)
sources.quote: arXiv abstract page for 2406.18521 (only version v1) links http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/ as the article licence (checked 2026-10-11). Owner note 2026-10-09: 'The CharXiv arXiv paper is CC BY-SA 4.0 and usable.' Table 11 'Run configurations for all models' documents the authors' own runs of every model.
sources.attribution: Zirui Wang et al. (Princeton NLP), CharXiv: Charting Gaps in Realistic Chart Understanding in Multimodal LLMs, arXiv:2406.18521v1, CC BY-SA 4.0. Test-set overall accuracies from Appendix C Table 4; percentages converted to fractions; model names mapped via Table 11. Adapted rows are distributed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (data/extracts). No endorsement.
sources.scope: Appendix C Table 4 test-split RQ All and DQ All for the 7 models whose Table 11 checkpoint is catalogued (gpt-4o-2024-05-13, gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09, Claude 3 Sonnet/Haiku/Opus, reka-flash-20240226, llava-v1.6-34b). Not used: Reka Core (reka-core-20240415 not catalogued), Gemini 1.0 Pro Vision, Qwen VL Max/Plus (no snapshot), Reka Edge and open models not in the catalogue.

sources.name: Canary-1B-v2 & Parakeet-TDT-0.6B-v3: Efficient and High-Performance Models for Multilingual ASR and AST (NVIDIA, arXiv:2509.14128v2)
sources.quote: arXiv abstract page for 2509.14128v2 links http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/ (checked 2026-10-11; v1 has the same licence); the HTML header states 'License: CC BY-SA 4.0'. Sec. 6.1: 'For comparative analysis, we consider several strong baselines ...' and normalized WER with the Open ASR normalizers including 'the newly added multilingual normalizer for non-English test sets'.
sources.attribution: Monica Sekoyan et al. (NVIDIA), Canary-1B-v2 & Parakeet-TDT-0.6B-v3, arXiv:2509.14128v2, CC BY-SA 4.0. Per-language WERs from Appendix Tables 11-13 averaged (unweighted) into the benchmark's language sets; percentages converted to fractions. Adapted rows are distributed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (data/extracts). No endorsement.
sources.scope: Appendix Tables 11-13 (FLEURS, MLS, CoVoST2 per-language WER) for models with every language of the benchmark set: whisper-large-v3 (all three), seamless-m4t-v2-large (MLS only; FLEURS and CoVoST2 lack Latvian), Parakeet-TDT-0.6B-v3 and Canary-1B-v2 (own, all three). Not used: Table 5 (Open ASR Leaderboard figures), Voxtral-Mini and Phi-4-multimodal (partial language coverage), seamless-m4t-medium (not catalogued), AST/COMET tables.

benchmarks.name: CharXiv reasoning questions (test split)
benchmarks.description: CharXiv reasoning-question accuracy on the held-out TEST split (1,323 charts, answers kept private, scored by the CharXiv authors), as printed in Appendix C Table 4 of arXiv:2406.18521v1. Different questions from charxiv-rq (validation split); not merged with it.
